traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Wikipedia, Cupressaceae (read 2026-10-16): leaves spiral, in crossing pairs, or in whorls of three or four by genus; family about 135 spp., most of the order, and most of them (cypresses, junipers, thujas) paired or in threes. Taxaceae and Cephalotaxaceae (about 35 spp.) spiral. Weighted by species.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: Wikipedia, Cupressaceae (read 2026-10-16): paired or whorled leaves alternate between nodes (decussate) in most of the family; spiral in the redwood/Taxodium group and in Taxaceae, Cephalotaxaceae.

traits.leaf_division.note: Wikipedia, Cupressaceae and Taxaceae (read 2026-10-16): leaves scales or needles, never divided.

traits.life_span.note: Wikipedia, Cupressaceae and Taxaceae (read 2026-10-16): trees and shrubs.

traits.rosette.note: Wikipedia, Cupressaceae and Taxaceae (read 2026-10-16): leaves along branches; Sciadopitys needles clustered in umbrella-like whorls at shoot ends, which is a whorl, not a rosette.
